detail.title: Structural and Institutional Drivers of Information Persistence
detail.summary: This synthesis evaluates the persistence of information through the lens of both technical error-correction (structural) and social selection (institutional).
detail.reason: Aligns project findings with active cross-project research on uncertainty and error detection.

detail.title: Mechanisms of Information Persistence
detail.question: What factors (structural, institutional, and technical) differentiate information that persists from information that decays?
detail.reason: Previous research identified that persistence requires a duality of technical error correction and institutional policy; current attention mandates expanding this synthesis using the collected evidence.

detail.title: Institutional Journal: Synthesis of Curiosity, Persistence, and Predictive Processing Models
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes foundational research across three active projects. We have codified findings on the role of predictive processing in curiosity-driven learning and music cognition, alongside a formal synthesis of information persistence mechanisms. These notebooks establish a baseline for future research by unifying available evidence.
